verification.miniature_scope_warning: 32 synthetic CPU rows, 5016 outputs, one epoch, width 16; comparator predictions, policy and minimum geographic support are controlled for deterministic acceptance. This tests plumbing, not predictive accuracy or full T4 runtime.

compact_output_capacity_check.scope: Released compact exporter on 3000 archived rows plus a conservative diagnostic-CSV/JSON projection; not a measured full Kaggle output.

limitations: No guaranteed leaderboard improvement, 12-hour completion or established SOTA
Cooperative guard cannot preempt stalled I/O or hardware
All PA labels and pilot calibration observations were consumed; repeated spatial gates are not independent evidence
Co-occurrence is observational and may propagate wrong predicted anchors
Fold-to-production calibration and feature transfer can differ despite frozen numerical coefficients
Counts and leading predictions remain fixed, limiting how large a useful correction can be
